data.headline: Lime pass plus Muni

picks.name: Lime (monthly pass)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest fast way between cofounder meetups
picks.insider: Most city trips take about 20 minutes

picks.name: Muni bus / metro
picks.one_liner: Cheap daytime café hopping on tight budget

picks.name: Waymo
picks.one_liner: Safe late rides after evening events
picks.insider: Try once; feels safer at night

data.watch_out: Skip BART inside SF; use it for airports only.

data.headline: Cheap day passes, Nob Hill

picks.name: coworking sf (via LANS)
picks.one_liner: Cheapest real day pass, quiet, open late
picks.insider: Book in LANS app; open 5am to 11:45pm

picks.name: AngelList Founders Café
picks.insider: Apply for access before you land

picks.name: Medium Café
picks.insider: Backup when day passes feel unnecessary

data.watch_out: Skip monthly desks; day passes win for under 4 weeks.

data.headline: Small rooms, hackathons, SPC

picks.name: South Park Commons
picks.one_liner: Pre-idea people hunting cofounders gather here
picks.insider: Events are high-signal; go to every one you can.

picks.name: Entrepreneurs First (EF)
picks.one_liner: Hackathons reveal how potential cofounders actually work
picks.insider: Go even if you won't win; meet builders.

picks.name: Luma (luma.com)
picks.one_liner: Find small dinners, skip loud mixers
picks.insider: Follow calendars, apply early; good ones fill fast.

data.watch_out: Short stay: post on X before landing.

data.headline: Mission, Valencia corridor, hacker house

picks.name: Hacker house in Mission / Valencia
picks.one_liner: Roommates are builders; cofounder pool at home.
picks.insider: Find openings via Luma/X posts, founder group chats.

picks.name: Hayes Valley / Duboce
picks.one_liner: Calm cafés, short ride to SoMa events.
picks.insider: Furnished sublets via Facebook groups, Furnished Finder.

picks.name: Shared room in SoMa / South Park
picks.one_liner: Walk to most founder events nightly.
picks.insider: Quiet at night; pick blocks carefully.

data.watch_out: Cheap 'Union Square' listings are often Tenderloin; never prewire deposits.
